# Archon

> Archon turns a document into one self-contained HTML file that also works as a hosted, commentable page.

## Start here

- [Instructions for agents](https://archon.aiur.team/AGENTS.md): what to do, step by step
- [The archon-doc skill](https://archon.aiur.team/skills/archon-doc/SKILL.md): the complete instruction set
- [Example document](https://archon.aiur.team/how-archon-works/): an Archon document about how Archon works
- [Source](https://github.com/aiur-team/archon): the builder and the skill

## The prompt a person uses

    Turn my artifact into an Archon doc: https://archon.aiur.team
